ladder.label: Today, as run
ladder.what: An estimate, not an appraisal: no authenticated financials, owned-audience analytics or Carter transactions yet

ladder.label: ~3 yrs · $15M revenue
ladder.what: Planning scenario: 20% EBITDA margin on $15M revenue, valued at 6–10×

ladder.label: ~3 yrs · strong build
ladder.what: Planning scenario: $3–5M EBITDA at 8–12×. A $75M strategic case would need 15× — and evidence of earning assets, durable contracts or synergies

ladder.label: Media + programs route
ladder.what: A deliberately ambitious scale target, not a forecast: $220M revenue less $30M central overhead gives $62M EBITDA (28.2%). At a 15% margin and 8×, the same revenue gives $264M

ladder.label: $500M company
ladder.what: Arithmetic, not an offer: at an assumed 20×, $500M needs $25M EBITDA — $125M revenue at a 20% margin

ladder.label: $1B franchise
ladder.what: One assumed architecture: $300M company revenue, $60M central costs, $85M EBITDA at 12× = $1.02B (at 20% margin and 8×: $480M)

stack.label: Story universe IP
stack.prove: Actual catalog earnings, renewals, costs and concentration. Roald Dahl's ~18× is a reported comparison, not yet reconciled to transaction price and same-period revenue.

stack.label: Clubs & Academy network
stack.prove: Profitable local operations or durable operator royalties. No universal youth-sports multiple exists: IMG Academy's $1.25B was enterprise value for an operating business; LOVB's $100M was capital raised.

stack.label: Licensing & consumer products
stack.prove: Licensee sell-through, minimum guarantees and renewal. Peanuts' ~23× describes one transaction's attributable earnings.

stack.label: Programs: schools & companies
stack.prove: Retention, delivery quality, margins and independence from Coach's attendance (FranklinCovey: $261.5M FY2026 revenue).

stack.label: Platform stakes (AI / micro-drama)
stack.prove: Counted at $0 until executed grants, ownership and realizable value exist. The review's $25–100M option value is not counted.
